title: Finish ASO / Retail Supreme rollout
detail: Move from 290K toward the 500K ASO-member target so most GT outlets order digitally.
expected_impact: Better sell-out visibility; higher SKUs per order

title: Rebuild Seasonings growth
detail: Seasonings revenue fell 7% in 2025; use outlet-level data to fix assortment gaps and push premium SKUs.
expected_impact: Recover the largest and highest-margin category

title: Scale demand-driven replenishment
detail: Connect ASO sell-out data with Supra forecasting so factories plan from real outlet demand.

title: Grow international supply capacity
detail: International revenue grew 27% in 2025; plan export-ready lines and overseas partner warehouses.
expected_impact: Path to 10% of revenue from abroad by 2030

title: Start Scope 3 decarbonisation with suppliers
detail: Quantify supplier emissions from 2026 and set joint reduction targets.
